description_en: Queries the storage usage of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的空间使用信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-resource-usage --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceUsage

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ArchiveBackupSize.description_en: The storage that is occupied by archived backup files on the instance. Unit: bytes
ArchiveBackupSize.description_zh: 归档备份的占用空间，单位：Byte

BackupDataSize.description_en: The storage that is occupied by data backup files, excluding archived backup files, on the instance. Unit: bytes
BackupDataSize.description_zh:
数据备份占用的总空间（不包括归档备份），单位：Byte。

对于SQL Server实例，表示物理备份和快照备份的总大小

BackupEcsSnapshotSize.description_en: The storage capacity that is used to store the snapshot backup files of the RDS for SQL Server instance. Unit: bytes. The value 0 indicates that no snapshot backup files are stored for the instance
BackupEcsSnapshotSize.description_zh: SQL Server实例的快照备份占用空间，单位：Byte。0表示没有数据

BackupLogSize.description_en: The storage that is occupied by log backup files, excluding archived backup files, on the instance. Unit: bytes
BackupLogSize.description_zh: 日志备份占用的总空间（不包括归档备份），单位：Byte

BackupOssDataSize.description_en: The size of data backup files that are stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets. Unit: bytes. The value 0 indicates no data backup files are stored in OSS buckets
BackupOssDataSize.description_zh:
OSS中备份集的数据文件大小，单位：Byte。0表示没有数据。

对于SQL Server实例，表示物理备份占用空间

BackupOssLogSize.description_en: The size of log backup files that are stored in OSS buckets. Unit: bytes. The value 0 indicates no log backup files are stored in OSS buckets
BackupOssLogSize.description_zh: OSS中备份集的日志文件大小，单位：Byte。0表示没有数据

BackupSize.description_en: The storage that is used to store backup files. Unit: bytes. The value -1 indicates that no backup files are stored
BackupSize.description_zh: 备份占用空间（数据备份+日志备份），单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

ColdBackupSize.description_en: The storage that is used to store cold backup files. Unit: bytes. The value -1 indicates that no cold backup files are stored
ColdBackupSize.description_zh: 冷备份的占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

DataSize.description_en: The storage that is used to store data files. Unit: bytes. The value -1 indicates that no data files are stored
DataSize.description_zh: 数据文件占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

DiskUsed.description_en: The total storage that is occupied by data files and log files on the instance. Unit: bytes. The value -1 indicates that no data files or log files are stored on the instance
DiskUsed.description_zh: 已用空间（DataSize+LogSize），单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

Engine.description_en: The database engine of the instance

LogSize.description_en: The storage that is used to store log files. Unit: bytes. The value -1 indicates that no log files are stored
LogSize.description_zh: 日志占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

PaidBackupSize.description_en: The backup storage for which you must pay. The system provides a free quota on backup storage. You must pay for the backup storage that exceeds the free quota. Unit: bytes
PaidBackupSize.description_zh: 扣除免费额度后，需要付费的备份占用空间，单位：Byte

SQLSize.description_en: The storage that is occupied to execute SQL statements on the instance. Unit: bytes. The value -1 indicates that no SQL statements are executed
SQLSize.description_zh: SQL的占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据
